entities.name: Mari Gerekmezyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mari Gerekmezyan was one of Turkey's first female sculptors and the first female Armenian sculptor. She was the lover of the Turkish poet and painter Bedri Rahmi Eyüboğlu.
